problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
detection_methods: Advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
User behavior analytics
SIEM alerts for suspicious login attempts
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
detection_methods: Threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
User behavior analytics
SIEM alerts for anomalous email patterns
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Educate employees on recognizing personalized phishing attempts
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees.
detection_methods: Email authentication protocols monitoring (DMARC, DKIM, SPF)
Anomaly detection on email forwarding rules
SIEM alerts for unusual login activity
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Monitor email accounts for unusual login activity and forwarding rules

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob) leading to data leakage or unauthorized access.
detection_methods: Automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools
SIEM alerts on anomalous data access patterns
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies
Use encryption for data at rest and in transit

problems.description: Attackers compromise software dependencies or update mechanisms to inject malicious code into widely distributed software.
detection_methods: Software bill of materials (SBOM) tracking
Integrity verification and code signing monitoring
Behavioral anomaly detection post-update
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) tracking
Use code signing and integrity verification
Monitor for anomalous behavior post-update

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model inputs to degrade or subvert AI/ML system performance.
detection_methods: Monitoring training data integrity
Anomaly detection on model outputs
Explainable AI techniques for model behavior analysis
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Use robust and explainable AI techniques
Monitor model behavior for anomalies

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio/video) to impersonate trusted individuals for social engineering or fraud.
detection_methods: Deepfake detection tools
Multi-channel verification processes
User awareness training on synthetic media risks
risk_reduction: Deploy deepfake detection tools

Increase user awareness of synthetic media risks

detection_methods: Network traffic analysis for data exfiltration
